description: Vercel is a cloud platform for building, deploying, and scaling web applications and AI workloads. It provides hosted infrastructure and tooling for projects, deployments, domains, analytics, and related account resources.
summary: Vercel exposes a public REST API on api.vercel.com, an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at mcp.vercel.com, and the `vercel` CLI; the REST API and CLI use Vercel access tokens, while MCP uses OAuth with dynamic client registration.
